title: Geometric Noetherian descent for a proper flat finite-presentation module
statement: Let f:X\to S be a proper quasi-compact locally finitely presented morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions], F a finitely presented module flat over f [pqf-def-coherent, def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over], U an open of S, and x a point of U. There are an open V of U containing x, an affine scheme T, a compact open W of T with W Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], a Noetherian scheme Y, a proper map p:Y\to W, and a finitely presented module M on Y flat over p. There are g:V\to W and q:X\times_S V\to Y such that the square with p,g and the projection X\times_S V\to V is cartesian [def-pc-fibre-product], and q^*M is isomorphic to the pullback of F to X\times_S V [def-pc-module-pullback]. No derived category or direct-image conclusion is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0A1H, Noetherian approximation paragraph; Tags 01ZM, 01ZR, 05LY and 081F

proof.text: Choose an affine neighbourhood V of x in U. Write its section ring as the filtered colimit of its finitely generated integer subalgebras. Spec preserves this limit, and transport its cone point through V.isoSpec. Restrict f and F to the original pullback over V; relative flatness is preserved. Descend the finitely presented restricted morphism using Scheme.exists_isPullback_of_finitePresentation.

Apply eventual properness to the descended morphism and the identity of its base. Its limit base change is proper by the unique pullback isomorphism. Pull back to this later proper stage, and paste the cartesian comparison squares.

Transport the restricted module to the canonical pullback model using the inverse of the unique scheme isomorphism. Tensor pullback preserves finite presentation. On affine sections its relative flatness is preserved because the isomorphism identifies the section rings and module actions. Apply AlgebraicGeometry.exists_flat_module_on_later_stage from WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.FlatModuleOnLaterStage (the identical adopted source realization of lem-pc-flat-module-on-later-stage) to get a later flat finitely presented module. Properness of the source morphism survives this base change. Compose tensor-pullback composition and identity isomorphisms to recover the original restricted F.

Take T to be the later spectrum and W its total open. Pull the proper source and its module back along T.topIso.hom, and lift the comparison to this pullback. Cartesian pasting proves the required square, and tensor-pullback composition proves the final sheaf isomorphism. W is compact and Noetherian, and Y is Noetherian since its morphism to W is quasi-compact and locally of finite type.
